about: Quality and speed, measured on every refactoring pass (the dev agent's mandate, WS-65): how many files a release changes, how long the build and the gate take, and how long CI takes. Append a row per pass; never edit an old one.

rows.note: after WS-83: generated output gitignored, CI builds and deploys

dev pass 1: CI three jobs -> two (validate uploads the pages it checked; no second build in deploy); gate reads each file once and skips the 14 MB of video; key-shape regex made linear; .gitignore 241 -> 24 lines. CI after: measured on the next wake.

dev pass 2 (WS-86): one shared list of secret shapes (admin/build/secrets.cjs) for check 5 and comms_check, with fixtures the gate must catch; comms_check also scans content/ and every text type; .gitignore guards key files again. CI measured is v0.1.44, the first two-job run (pass 1 recorded null). Validate +0.07 s for scanning content/.
